FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: ClearView Glass Solutions specializes in residential glass installation and repair, offering comprehensive services such as window replacement, glass repair, and related maintenance tasks. Our team is composed of trained professionals committed to providing high-quality workmanship while adhering to strict safety protocols. We operate primarily in environments that ensure our projects are manageable and safe. Our business emphasizes safety through regular training sessions for our employees, and we have implemented documented vehicle maintenance programs to ensure the safe transport of glass panels. We maintain strong relationships with reputable suppliers and ensure thorough vetting of any subcontractors we may engage, always requiring proof of insurance. Our services are designed to meet local building codes and regulatory requirements, cementing our commitment to compliance and customer satisfaction.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 5, 2023, we experienced a minor incident where a glass panel was damaged during transportation due to improper load securing. The cost of the damaged glass amounted to $1,200. The issue has been resolved, and we have since implemented a stricter load securing protocol to prevent future occurrences.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 9:00 AM - 3:00 PM; Closed on Sunday.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and onsite watchpersons for enhanced protection during glass transportation and installation.
